rektion: jdm./etw. (Dat.) etw. (Akk.) überlassen (die Entscheidung dir überlassen, etw. dem Zufall überlassen)
meaning_en: to leave (a decision/thing) to someone or something; to hand over
definition_de: jemand anderen (oder etwas anderes) entscheiden oder etwas haben lassen; auch: jdm. etw. zur Nutzung geben (Er überließ uns seine Wohnung.)
example_de: Weil er sich nicht entscheiden konnte, überließ er die Wahl des Weges dem Zufall.
example_en: Because he could not decide, he left the choice of path to chance.
user_example_de: Soll ich versuchen, meine Entscheidungen meinem Bauchgefühl zu überlassen?
visual_idea: Collocation 'etw. dem Zufall überlassen': a hiker at a fork in a forest path flips a coin instead of choosing himself. Giving the decision away is visible, and it has the same structure as 'die Entscheidung dem Bauchgefühl überlassen'.
image_prompt: a young hiker with a backpack standing at a fork where a forest path splits into two clearly different paths, one sunny path to the left and one dark misty path to the right, he has just flipped a silver coin with his thumb and the coin is spinning high in the air above his hand, he watches it with a relaxed shrug, wide shot
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_prompt: a hiker stands at a fork in a forest path, looks left and right, shrugs, flips a silver coin high into the air with his thumb, catches it on the back of his hand, looks at it and walks onto the left path; static wide camera
